neighbours.label: the verb or pronoun that closes a that-less relative clause about the speaker's or listener's own stance or situation (the method I advocate, right where you are), as against the same verbs in main clauses
fire: This is precisely the routine I advocate for new runners.
Talk to someone older; they have stood exactly where you are today.
She explained the diet plan she was promoting on her blog.
Here is the simple budgeting system I swear by every month.
It took years to reach the level of calm I preach in my workshops.
Friends who have been where you are can offer real comfort.
He finally accepted the theory his rival had been defending for years.
That is the kind of training I champion in every team I coach.
